days.top_line: Oil's Hormuz standoff pushed the Sensex to close down 1.5% at a multi-week low, while Bitcoin eased toward $83,200. India's threatened bank strike was called off, and South Africa'
Sunday was tense: UK police foiled a bomb plot near a base used in US strikes on Iran. Kohli passed 15,000 ODI runs, and Anthropic claimed major AI science breakthroughs.
